section.title: Mail Pickup Services FAQ
section.description: Common questions about Broadstroke's daily mail pickup, presort processing, and concierge integration for Wichita-area businesses.

faqs.q: What types of mail does Broadstroke pick up daily?
faqs.a: Broadstroke collects standard letters, flats and large envelopes, parcels, priority mail, certified mail, international mail, EDDM, nonprofit, and marketing mail. Our professional mailroom staff handles sorting and presort postage application for eligible pieces.

faqs.q: Do I need to prepare mail in a specific way before pickup?
faqs.a: For presort postage, separate pieces needing postage from pre-metered items. Flats and large envelopes should be sealed with tape over metal clasps. Handwritten addresses must use black ink and allow proper space at the bottom to qualify for presort rates. We provide guidance on USPS-compliant formatting.

faqs.q: Can Broadstroke deliver print or promotional product orders during mail pickup?
faqs.a: Yes. A key convenience of our service is the ability to deliver completed commercial printing or branded promotional items on the same daily visit, eliminating extra trips and vendor coordination.

faqs.q: How does Postalocity integrate with mail pickup services?
faqs.a: Postalocity automates document upload, address verification, high-speed printing, folding, stuffing, and insertion with 100% accuracy checks. Broadstroke then provides physical daily pickup and USPS submission for hybrid workflows, combining digital efficiency with concierge handling.

faqs.q: Is support available for certified mail?
faqs.a: Yes. We accept sealed certified pieces and provide forms and mailing labels. For complete automation, Postalocity handles printing, addressing, insertion, proof of mailing, USPS tracking, and optional signature notifications.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for Broadstroke mail pickup services?
faqs.a: Businesses of all sizes in the Wichita area and surrounding regions that generate regular outbound mail benefit from our service. We serve utilities, healthcare practices, financial institutions, real estate firms, municipalities, ad agencies, and more.

faqs.q: Does Broadstroke charge extra rates for presort postage?
faqs.a: No. We apply presort rates to eligible pieces with no additional markup and pass along the discounted pricing. Mail with pre-applied postage is accepted when properly sealed and separated from pieces requiring our postage application.

faqs.q: How does Broadstroke maintain USPS compliance and best rates?
faqs.a: As a member of the National Association of Presort Mailers (NAPM), Broadstroke stays current with USPS standards and innovations. Our team ensures proper addressing, sorting, tray preparation, and documentation to support rate optimization and reduce returned mail.
